$schema-note: Curated per-screen prose for the production pattern library (#223). The screen inventory, composition, state contract, and ownership callbacks are DERIVED from the @beeui/showcase pattern sources by scripts/generate-pattern-library.mjs; this file holds only `purpose` (what the screen is) and `excluded` (the application logic it intentionally leaves to the caller). Every showcase pattern screen MUST have an entry with non-empty `purpose` and `excluded`. `pnpm docs:patterns:check` fails on a missing/extra entry.

forgot-password-screen.purpose: Request a password-reset code for an account email.
forgot-password-screen.excluded: Sending the reset email, rate limiting, and account lookup.

interests-onboarding-screen.purpose: Let a new user pick interest topics during onboarding.
interests-onboarding-screen.excluded: Topic catalog fetching and persistence of selected interests.

password-updated-screen.purpose: Confirmation surface after a password change succeeds.
password-updated-screen.excluded: The password mutation and any post-change session handling.

profile-setup-screen.purpose: Collect display name, username, bio, and photo for a new profile.
profile-setup-screen.excluded: Username availability checks, image upload, and profile persistence.

reset-password-screen.purpose: Enter and confirm a new password behind a reset flow.
reset-password-screen.excluded: Reset-token validation and the password mutation.

sign-in-screen.purpose: Email/password sign-in with social and forgot-password affordances.
sign-in-screen.excluded: Credential verification, OAuth flows, and session creation.

sign-up-screen.purpose: Account creation with terms acceptance and social sign-up.
sign-up-screen.excluded: Account creation, validation rules, OAuth, and terms storage.

verify-code-screen.purpose: Enter a one-time verification code with resend and destination change.
verify-code-screen.excluded: Code delivery, verification, and resend throttling.

welcome-screen.purpose: First-run welcome surface routing to get-started or sign-in.

analytics-screen.purpose: Range-filtered analytics dashboard with metric summaries.
analytics-screen.excluded: Metric aggregation, data fetching, and chart rendering.

dashboard-overview-screen.purpose: Finance dashboard overview with balances, activity, and primary actions.
dashboard-overview-screen.excluded: Data fetching, invoice creation, and navigation.

invoice-detail-screen.purpose: Read-only invoice detail with download and share actions.
invoice-detail-screen.excluded: Invoice retrieval, PDF generation, and share transport.

payment-methods-screen.purpose: List and manage saved payment methods.

subscription-screen.purpose: Current subscription plan with upgrade, manage, and cancel actions.

transaction-detail-screen.purpose: Read-only transaction detail with receipt and help actions.

transactions-screen.purpose: Searchable, filterable transaction list with loading/error/retry states.
transactions-screen.excluded: Query execution, pagination, and data fetching.

wallet-screen.purpose: Wallet home with accounts, balances, and money-movement actions.

cart-screen.purpose: Shopping cart with quantity edits, removal, and checkout.
cart-screen.excluded: Cart persistence, pricing/tax calculation, and checkout routing.

checkout-screen.purpose: Order review with address editing and place-order action.
checkout-screen.excluded: Address validation, payment capture, and order creation.

messages-screen.purpose: Conversation list for a direct-messages inbox.
messages-screen.excluded: Message fetching, realtime updates, and thread navigation.

notifications-screen.purpose: Notification feed with mark-read and selection.

order-detail-screen.purpose: Order detail with reorder and support actions.
order-detail-screen.excluded: Order retrieval, reorder logic, and support routing.

post-detail-screen.purpose: Social post detail with like, share, and comment submission.

product-detail-screen.purpose: Product detail with add-to-cart and favorite actions.
product-detail-screen.excluded: Product fetching, inventory, and cart mutations.

product-feed-screen.purpose: Browsable product grid with search and favorites.
product-feed-screen.excluded: Catalog fetching, search execution, and favorite persistence.

product-search-screen.purpose: Product search results with sort and filter affordances.
product-search-screen.excluded: Search execution, sorting/filtering logic, and data fetching.

social-feed-screen.purpose: Social timeline with like, comment, share, and compose.
social-feed-screen.excluded: Feed fetching, realtime updates, and post persistence.

user-profile-screen.purpose: Public user profile with follow and post-open actions.

account-screen.purpose: Account hub with linked accounts, devices, sign-out, and delete.
account-screen.excluded: Account data fetching and destructive account mutations.

change-password-screen.excluded: Password verification and the change mutation.

edit-profile-screen.purpose: Edit profile fields and avatar with save.
edit-profile-screen.excluded: Avatar upload, validation, and profile persistence.

privacy-security-screen.purpose: Privacy and security settings hub with sessions and 2FA entries.
privacy-security-screen.excluded: Session management, 2FA setup, and data-export execution.

profile-screen.purpose: Personal profile summary routing to edit, account, and activity.

settings-screen.purpose: Top-level settings menu routing to account, privacy, and appearance.
